text:
frank: opened PR to fix the API reference for POST /v1/generate (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513). Running the new Java SDK smoke tests surfaced a couple of schema mismatches.

frank: problems I hit:
- `max_context_tokens` is documented as `integer` but the runtime accepts `null` to mean "use model default" and we also accept the string `auto` in the hosted API for autosizing. The strict OpenAPI integer-only schema breaks generated clients.
- response example in the ref omits the optional `partial` boolean we attach when a response is returned incrementally (non-streaming fallback). Some ingestion pipelines rely on that flag to stitch messages.
- a curl example in the docs used an outdated endpoint `/v1/complete` (leftover) instead of `/v1/generate`. CI link checker flagged it.

anya: can you paste the broken snippets so i can update openapi.yaml and the examples?

frank: current param snippet (incorrect):
```yaml
parameters:
  max_context_tokens:
    type: integer
    minimum: 1
```
should be (proposal):
```yaml
parameters:
  max_context_tokens:
    oneOf:
      - type: integer
      - type: string
      - type: 'null'
    description: "Number of context tokens to use, 'auto' to let server pick, or null to use model default"
```

frank: current response example (docs only show id/choices/tokens):
```json
{
  "id": "r-77",
  "choices": [{"text": "ok"}],
  "tokens": 10
}
```
runtime can emit an extra field when we finish via an early return: 
```json
{
  "id": "r-77",
  "choices": [{"text": "ok"}],
  "tokens": 10,
  "partial": true,
  "metadata": {"served_by": "pool-4"}
}
```

luca: +1 to the oneOf change. generators that make TypeScript types will produce union types which is what we want. For `null` make sure the OpenAPI uses a proper null type (some generators expect `nullable: true`), but i think oneOf with a literal null is safer.

mina: about the response `partial` field, we should mark it optional on the response schema and document the semantics: "partial: true indicates result may be incomplete and later a complete version will be emitted via a follow-up notification or stream". Also add a short snippet to the API ref showing how to handle it.

frank: good call. i added a tiny JS example in the PR preview:
```js
if (resp.partial) {
  // mark for re-check; do not surface to end-user as final
  console.warn('received partial result', resp.id)
}
```

docs-ci: link-checker found an outdated endpoint reference in docs/examples/quickstart.md: `/v1/complete` -> should be `/v1/generate`

frank: fixed the broken curl snippet and rebased. Also updated the migration notes under docs/migration/v1.6.md reminding typed-client users to regenerate because max_context_tokens now accepts string/null.

luca: small nit: please add an example value for `max_context_tokens` in the param doc so rendered docs show `auto` as an example instead of only integers.

mina: also add a sentence in the response docs warning that `metadata` is unstable telemetry. we don't want consumers to depend on keys like `served_by`.

frank: added example `auto` and wording for metadata. pushed. CI re-run.

docs-ci: All checks passed \u2705 (lint, link-check, openapi-check)

anya: reviewed the YAML changes, LGTM. small wording nit on the `partial` description which i fixed in a follow-up commit.

luca: approved from eng. i'll kick off the TS client regen once this lands.

frank: merged. i'll open follow-ups to propagate the `partial` handling snippet into the JS SDK README and add a short test in the Java SDK to accept `max_context_tokens=null` and `auto`. thanks all!

mina: nice, this should reduce a class of annoying TypeErrors we were seeing. :tada:
